title: Not As Pictured
text: Not As Pictured. Add me to the many reviewers who received a burner with a metal insert. The metal quickly discolors, leaving many brownish spots in the bowl portion. You really need to add water when burning as the oil doesn’t last nearly as long in metal as opposed to soapstone.
